description.value: A McDonald's fast-food restaurant on Cambie Road in Richmond, offering the full Canadian menu including burgers, chicken sandwiches, breakfast, McCafé beverages, and desserts. The location includes a drive-through and takeout service, making it a convenient and reliable stop for cyclists moving through the area. As a well-known chain with consistent service, it offers an easy resupply point on a busy arterial road.
